# Business case v3: OEE, predictive maintenance and AI & IoT (calibrated)

**Latest version, 12 November 2026.** The Excel model is the main document: [`v3-business-case-model.xlsx`](v3-business-case-model.xlsx). It is generated by [`build-model-v3.py`](build-model-v3.py) (Python + openpyxl), so it can be rebuilt after a change.

| Version | What it is |
|---|---|
| v1 | Group concept: 15–25% extra capacity = €300–500 m extra revenue |
| v2 | Benefits from avoided downtime, maintenance and quality only (≈ €12 m/yr), ≈ €24 m investment |
| **v3** | The group concept ([`materials/group-drafts/…concept (1).docx`](../../materials/group-drafts/)) calibrated against peer figures (Ariston, BDR Thermea, Bosch Home Comfort) and industry benchmarks; four AI & IoT levers; three options; 3-year P&L, TCO, NPV and stress tests |

## Tabs

1. **Explainer**: the qualitative business case and live headline numbers.
2. **Assumptions & Refs**: every input with Low / Base / High, label (case, group, source, assumption) and industry reference; scenario and option selectors; calibration table (concept vs calibrated); reference list.
3. **P&L TCO NPV**: impact per lever, benefit build-up, 3-year P&L (baseline, programme effect, pro-forma), TCO, end-to-end cost build-up, cash flow and NPV (3/5/7 years), options A/B/C compared, calculation engine.
4. **Sensitivity & Stress**: S1 demand × OEE uplift, S2 cost overrun, S3 benefit capture × delay, S4 discount rate × horizon; four combined stress scenarios; break-even points.

## Result (base scenario, option C "Full AI & IoT")

| | Value |
|---|---|
| OEE | 65.2% → 68.4%; capacity +4.5% (concept: +15–25%) |
| Run-rate gross benefit | ≈ €33 m/yr; EBITDA after run cost ≈ €22.5 m/yr from 2031 |
| One-off cost, end-to-end | ≈ €54 m (incl. 15% contingency); TCO ≈ €76 m (3 yrs), €96 m (5 yrs) |
| NPV at 8% | ≈ −€29 m (3 yrs), ≈ −€1 m (5 yrs), ≈ +€21 m (7 yrs); payback ≈ 4.6 yrs; IRR (7 yrs) ≈ 24% |
| Options, NPV 7 yrs | A (PdM only) ≈ −€8 m · B (OEE + PdM) ≈ +€10 m · C (all four) ≈ +€21 m |
| CFO downside | negative (≈ −€25 m over 7 yrs): scale only through gates |

Messages for the board:

1. The concept's 15–25% capacity gain is not credible: it needs OEE near world class and 4–6× peer growth. A calibrated programme gives ≈ 3–8% capacity (Low–High).
2. The foundation is a 5–7 year investment, not a 3-year one. It only pays when several use cases run on it (A < B < C): the financial argument for one group standard.
3. Demand (sellable share) and adoption decide the case. Hence gated waves with pilot data, which matches the central message.

All figures are labelled; no number is a pilot result. Public sources are in [`../../context/sources.md`](../../context/sources.md) (section "Business case v3").
